scope: CPU-only integration smoke on previously published synthetic batch-validation rows; not new held-out evidence, a benchmark, a production memory profile, or evidence of GPU batch separability.
execution: Load the offline pinned CPU checkpoint once, build a fresh descriptive serial-versus-two-row validation report from these already disclosed cases, then run each group through the experimental broker and compare both routed outputs with individual resident-worker outputs. Observe model entry shapes and cooperative host/device lease cleanup. A cancellation race is tested separately with a small synthetic CPU model.
limits: The runtime identity and reservations are local development declarations, not measured worst-case limits or production authorization. These same inputs are reused for validation and integration. Record incomplete failures rather than replacing them.
